annotations.title: Get an atilab.io page as markdown

description: Fetches one atilab.io page as clean markdown (navigation and scripts removed), with frontmatter for title, description and canonical URL. Input is the page path ("/about", "solutions/insurance", "/" for the homepage) or a full https://www.atilab.io URL. Other domains are refused.

path.description: Page path or full atilab.io URL.

name: atilab_get_page
title: Get an atilab.io page as markdown
